questions.scenario: You are packing for a 5-day family trip. What is your style?

options.text: I pack at the last minute but I am super fast at fixing any emergencies during the trip.
I organize my suitcase with separate pouches for everything so I know exactly where my stuff is.
I make a checklist app or system so I never have to think about what to pack ever again.
I tell everyone else what to pack and make sure we don't carry extra luggage to save space.

questions.scenario: Your school WhatsApp group is a total mess with 500 messages a day.

options.text: I jump in only when there is a major fight or crisis to calm things down.
I suggest creating separate groups for 'Studies', 'Memes', and 'Announcements'.
I add a WhatsApp bot that automatically replies to common questions like 'When is the test?'.
I become the Admin and strictly kick out people who send useless good morning forwards.

questions.scenario: You are playing a city-building game (like SimCity or Clash of Clans).

options.text: I love the thrill of repairing my buildings fast when someone attacks my city.
I design the perfect road network and place storage units logically for maximum efficiency.
I set up automatic gold and elixir collectors so the city runs even when I am offline.
I trade resources smartly to ensure my city never runs out of money.

questions.scenario: Your phone displays 'Storage Almost Full'. What is your immediate action?

options.text: I quickly delete random heavy videos right when I need to click a new photo.
I neatly upload everything to Google Drive, categorizing photos by year and month.
I turn on 'Auto-Backup' so my photos sync quietly in the background every night.
I check my subscriptions to see if buying 100GB of extra cloud storage is worth the money.

questions.scenario: Right in the middle of an intense online match, your Wi-Fi stops working.

options.text: I sprint to the router, restart it, and fix the cables in 10 seconds flat.
I log into the router settings to diagnose exactly why the IP address dropped.
I quickly switch my phone to auto-hotspot so the connection shifts seamlessly.
I call the internet provider and demand they fix it or refund my day's money.

questions.scenario: Mummy gives you a long list of groceries to order on Blinkit/Zepto.

options.text: I order it fast, and if an item is missing, I run to the local shop to fix the crisis.
I organize the cart by 'Dairy', 'Snacks', and 'Veggies' so it's easy to unpack.
I save the list as 'Monthly Groceries' so next time I can reorder it in one tap.
I compare prices between Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart to save ₹50 on delivery.

questions.scenario: Every morning, you have a routine before going to school. How do you handle it?

options.text: I wake up late but rush like a superhero to get dressed and catch the bus on time.
I arrange my uniform, bag, and shoes perfectly the night before in a specific spot.
I find lifehacks (like showering and brushing teeth together) to automate and speed up my day.
I negotiate with my sibling to iron my shirt in exchange for doing their homework.

questions.scenario: Your computer has 100 messy files downloaded on the desktop.

options.text: I only search for the file I need using the search bar when I am in a hurry.
I create main folders like 'School', 'Games', and 'Movies' and put everything in its place.
I write a small script or use a tool that automatically sorts files by type every week.
I delete 80% of them because I hate digital clutter wasting my system's energy.

questions.scenario: In a school group project, what is your superpower?

options.text: Fixing things at the last minute when someone else messes up the presentation.
Structuring the entire Google Doc with proper headings, index, and fonts.
Finding tools that can generate our charts and references automatically.
Keeping track of who is working and making sure the project finishes on time.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube videos satisfy you the most?

options.text: Videos of people fixing broken phones or restoring rusted cars.
Videos explaining how massive things like airports or shipping ports are designed.
Satisfying videos of factory machines perfectly packaging items on a conveyor belt.
Videos about how companies like Amazon save millions of dollars in logistics.

Site_Reliability_Engineer.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
Site_Reliability_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate firefighter! You stay calm under pressure, love solving emergencies, and are incredibly fast at fixing broken things.
Site_Reliability_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Jumping into action when an app like Netflix or Instagram goes down, fixing servers, and bringing the website back online.
Site_Reliability_Engineer.alternative_match_text: Because of your quick reflexes and problem-solving skills, you would also be amazing in Cyber Security Incident Response or Core IT Support.
Site_Reliability_Engineer.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Computer Science and learn Linux.

Cloud_Architect.title: Cloud Architect
Cloud_Architect.primary_match_text: You are a master organizer. You love structure, clean systems, and designing large setups where everything has its perfect place.
Cloud_Architect.day_in_the_life: Drawing out the blueprint of how a company's data will be stored on Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Cloud_Architect.alternative_match_text: Your highly logical and structural brain makes you a perfect fit for Database Management or Systems Engineering.
Cloud_Architect.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in CSE or IT, and aim for AWS/Azure certifications.

Automation_DevOps_Engineer.title: DevOps & Automation Engineer
Automation_DevOps_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are the efficiency hacker! You hate doing the same boring task twice, so you find smart ways to automate everything.
Automation_DevOps_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Writing code that automatically tests and releases new updates to apps without human intervention.
Automation_DevOps_Engineer.alternative_match_text: If you love automating tasks, you would also excel as a Backend Developer or AI/Machine Learning Engineer.
Automation_DevOps_Engineer.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Computer Science and learn Python and automation tools.

Cloud_Operations_Manager.title: Cloud Operations & FinOps Manager
Cloud_Operations_Manager.primary_match_text: You are the smart controller. You understand technology but prefer to manage the rules, reduce waste, and save money.
Cloud_Operations_Manager.day_in_the_life: Monitoring massive server systems, optimizing costs so the company doesn't waste money, and leading the tech teams.
Cloud_Operations_Manager.alternative_match_text: With your optimization and management skills, you would naturally shine as an IT Project Manager or Tech Business Analyst.
Cloud_Operations_Manager.roadmap: Take Commerce or PCM in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA in IT, or a B.Tech followed by an MBA.
